description:
**An SSH MCP server — a multitool that saves you and your AI agent time and tokens on debugging, development and server maintenance.** 

Run commands, move files, read logs and audit machines over SSH: a  cloud VPS, a bare-metal box, or the BusyBox router in your closet.

  It uses the OpenSSH client already on your machine — your keys, your `~/.ssh/config`, your jump hosts, your  agent forwarding. Nothing bundled, nothing to compile, no native bindings.

  **18 tools:** run commands and detach long ones as background jobs, move files and whole trees with sha256  verification, search and tail logs, snapshot load and disk, audit a machine in one round trip, check TLS  certificates, inspect services.

  **Built for agents, not for humans.** Answers come back structured, a truncated result is reported as
  truncated instead of passing for a complete one, and destructive commands are stopped before they run.

  Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Hermes and any MCP client.
